analysis:
CHANGELOG.md only: documentation changes with no executable or security-policy modifications. Base excerpt (lines 1447-1717) contains older release notes. Head excerpt (lines 1-229) adds prose describing Bedrock review/merge clearance, account erasure, the soft-delete mutation gate, frozen legacy MDM cohort, and coordinator upgrade safety. Those items are described as shipped elsewhere; this PR only records them, and the supplied diff does not show their implementing code. I could not verify the described behavior against source, so the entries are unvalidated claims.

Threat-model-relevant statements noted for later passes: frozen legacy MDM cohort and /v1/enroll authentication (TB-009, TB-005, TB-011, T-036, T-052); App Attest required for noncohort owner routing and for base rewards (TB-011, T-052..T-055); soft-delete mutation gate defaulting to false (T-059); removal of caller-supplied user/metadata/safety_identifier/prompt_cache_key from provider-bound bodies (A-001, T-003); log scrubbing of emails/IPs/serials (T-051, T-058); admin erasure and the Stripe outbox (TB-006, TB-008, T-059); an unreleased Bedrock/OpenRouter review with merge clearance that depends on a separate verified rollout. The changelog says Medium/high findings and review-control changes require an independent formal override.

No concrete security regression is introduced by this diff. Any claim-versus-code mismatch would need review of the actual implementing PRs.
